title: crataegus crus-galli f. truncata
intro: Crataegus crus-galli f. truncata, commonly known as a cultivar of the common hawthorn plant, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support cardiovascular health, with its health benefits including reducing blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and enhancing cardiac function. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus crus-galli f. truncata are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improve blood vessel function, and exert antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, such as quercetin and epicatechin, as well as oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs) and other phenolic compounds.
